TASK BRIEF: Submit Jira development information for an integration (Jira Software Cloud API)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request provides an endpoint for submitting development information to Jira, which supports the stated Jira integration goal. No supplied requests were dropped.

AUTH
  Authorization header authentication
  Header: Authorization — string, such as a Connect JWT or OAuth token appropriate for the Jira integration; supply it in place of {{Authorization}}. The collection also documents Basic authentication with an account email and API token, but the request explicitly uses the Authorization header rather than declaring Basic auth.

BASE URL
  https://{{domain}}.atlassian.net
  Replace {{domain}} with the Jira site domain, currently shown as <your-domain-here> in the collection variables.

STEPS
  1. POST /rest/devinfo/0.10/bulk
     Params (headers):
       Authorization: string — 'Bearer <oauth-token>' or the applicable Connect JWT; send as the Authorization header.
       Content-Type: string — 'application/json'; send as the Content-Type header.
     Params (body):
       JSON payload — the request schema provides an empty raw body and does not specify the required development-information fields or their structure.
     Returns:
       No saved response example is provided. The request description indicates that the submission is processed asynchronously and that the development data eventually becomes available in Jira.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Replace both {{domain}} and {{Authorization}}; neither value is resolved by the supplied collection context beyond the placeholder domain value.
  - Send the body as JSON, but the supplied schema does not define the payload fields or nesting, so obtain the bulk development-information payload format from the Jira DevInfo API documentation.
  - Submissions are asynchronous; acceptance does not necessarily mean the data is immediately visible in Jira.
  - Existing repository and entity data with the same ID is replaced only when the incoming updateSequenceId is newer than the existing value.
